content: Liverpool are closing in on a deal to sign forward Bradley Barcola, which will increase doubts over Cody Gakpo's future.

title: Do Wrexham have a defensive problem?

title: The tiny town aiming to defy odds in Bundesliga debut
summary: Elversberg, a small German town with 13,000 residents and no railway station, achieves historic Bundesliga promotion after a meteoric rise through regional leagues.
content: Elversberg has no train station and a population of just 13,000, but its football team have enjoyed a meteoric rise from the regional German leagues to the Bundesliga.

title: The 50-year-old amateur footballer who became a viral inspiration
